title: Mid-Year Financial Reset: Digital Campaign for Young Professionals
objective: Capture mid-year financial planning intent from young professionals (25–40) during school holidays when families discuss money; drive sign-ups for fintech products (savings, investment, budgeting tools) with 20 qualified leads and 8% conversion rate.
target_audience: Young professionals (25–40), parents managing household finances, first-time investors; HHI SGD 80K–200K; active on Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn.
key_activities: 3-week paid Meta/TikTok campaign targeting financial planning intent (keywords: mid-year review, savings goals, investment)
8 organic social posts (Instagram Reels, TikTok) on money myths, budget hacks, investment basics
2 influencer partnerships (micro-influencers, personal finance creators, 50K–200K followers) for authentic testimonials
1 retargeting email sequence (3 emails) to warm leads, nurturing to demo/signup
Weekly performance dashboard reporting ROAS, CAC, CTR, conversion rate
kpis: 20 qualified leads (demo requests or email signups)
why_now: July school holidays mean families reassess finances; mid-year review is natural trigger for savings/investment decisions. Young professionals are active on social during downtime. TikTok/Instagram engagement peaks in SG during holidays.
deliverables: Custom paid campaign strategy (audience segmentation, creative variants, bid strategy)
8 organic social posts (Reels, TikTok, carousel formats)
3 influencer content pieces (testimonial videos, product reviews, reels)
1 email nurture sequence (3 emails, templates + copy)
Weekly performance reports (ROAS, CAC, conversions)
1 post-campaign analysis with optimization recommendations

title: Fintech Innovation Summit 2026: Flagship Thought Leadership Event
objective: Position sponsor bank/fintech as innovation leader; attract 300 decision-makers (CFOs, treasurers, startup founders, regulators) for 1-day conference; generate 25 qualified B2B leads and establish sponsor brand credibility.
target_audience: CFOs, treasurers, business owners, startup founders, fintech entrepreneurs, MAS regulators, investment firms; SG-based or regional.
key_activities: Full event production: venue booking (150–200 pax capacity), AV/lighting, catering
Speaker lineup (5–6 industry experts, sponsor representative as headline speaker)
Sponsor branding (logo placement, booth space, speaking slot, post-event PR)
Live-streaming + social media coverage (Instagram/LinkedIn live, 3–4 daily posts during event)
Post-event lead nurture (attendee database, email follow-up, 1:1 meetings scheduled)
kpis: 25 qualified B2B leads (sponsor introductions + lead form completions)
500 social media impressions during live stream
3 media mentions (press release, fintech blogs, LinkedIn articles)
why_now: July is school holiday planning season; professionals catch up on industry trends. Post-mid-year, companies plan H2 initiatives. Fintech sector is actively hiring and fundraising in SG (growth window).
deliverables: Venue secured + run-of-show (full schedule, speaker briefs, AV technical specs)
Sponsor package design (logo placement, booth design specs, speaking slot brief)
5–6 speaker confirmations + speaker bios/headshots for promotion
Event website or landing page (registration, speaker bios, agenda)
Live streaming setup (YouTube/LinkedIn, 3–4 social posts during event)
Photography + event recap video (3–5 min highlight reel)
Post-event attendee database with lead qualification scoring
3 media/PR placements (press release, fintech media outreach)

title: Holiday Savings Challenge: Influencer-Driven Brand Activation
objective: Launch interactive savings challenge during school holidays; use 5–8 micro-influencers to drive user sign-ups, engagement, and social word-of-mouth; target 1,500 challenge participants and 15% engagement rate (posts, shares, leaderboard interaction).
target_audience: Parents (30–50), young professionals (25–40), students (18–25); saving-conscious, active on Instagram/TikTok; HHI SGD 60K–180K.
key_activities: 5–8 micro-influencers (50K–150K followers each) co-create challenge concept and rules
Challenge landing page/app: leaderboard, progress tracking, weekly prize draws
Influencer content: 3 posts each (launch, week 2 update, week 4 wrap-up); behind-scenes content
User-generated content campaign: branded hashtag, repost best participant stories
Prize fulfillment: weekly S$100–300 gift cards, final grand prize (S$1,000–2,000 fintech product bundle)
Weekly social media amplification: 6 organic brand posts, 2 paid boosts per week
kpis: 3,000 new followers (aggregate across influencer partners + brand)
why_now: July school holidays = families focus on kids' activities and savings goals. Influencers have peak engagement during downtime. Challenge-based campaigns thrive in summer when people have more leisure time.
deliverables: Influencer recruitment + briefing (5–8 confirmed partnerships with contracts)
Challenge mechanics document (rules, leaderboard logic, prize schedule)
Landing page/simple web app (sign-up, leaderboard, social integration)
15 influencer posts (3 per influencer × 5 influencers; includes captions, hashtags)
6 organic brand social posts (launch, weekly updates, winner announcements)
2 paid social boosts per week (4 boosted posts total, S$400–600/week)
User-generated content curation (weekly highlights, repost 10–15 best submissions)
Prize fulfillment coordination (gift card orders, grand prize logistics)
Post-campaign report: participant demographics, engagement breakdown, influencer ROI

title: Fintech Rebrand Campaign: Visual Identity & Market Launch
objective: Execute full rebrand (logo, color palette, brand guidelines, messaging) for fintech company; launch new identity across digital touchpoints; drive market awareness with 2,500 web visits, 35 demo requests, 12% increase in brand search volume.
target_audience: Existing customers (retention messaging), new prospects (B2B and B2C), tech-savvy millennials/Gen Z (18–40), business decision-makers.
key_activities: Brand strategy workshop + positioning refinement (3 sessions)
Visual identity design (logo, color palette, typography, icon system)
Brand guidelines document (60+ pages: applications, do's/don'ts)
Website redesign (homepage, product pages, about, contact; mobile-responsive)
Launch campaign: 1 brand film (60–90 sec), 12 social posts, 3 email announcements
PR push: media outreach, thought leadership article, launch press release
Post-launch monitoring: brand sentiment analysis, search volume tracking
kpis: 2,500 website visits in first 4 weeks post-launch
35 demo requests (new prospects filling contact form)
70% positive brand sentiment (social listening, PR coverage)
why_now: July is ideal for brand refresh announcements (H2 planning season); positions company for second-half growth initiatives. School holidays mean business audiences have time to absorb brand messaging.
deliverables: Brand strategy document (positioning, messaging pillars, tone/voice guidelines)
Visual identity suite (logo files, color palette, typography, icon set, Figma assets)
Comprehensive brand guidelines (60+ pages PDF, applications, visual examples)
Redesigned website (5–8 pages, mobile-responsive, CMS-ready)
1 brand film (60–90 sec, professional production, captions, SRT files)
12 social media launch posts (Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok; varied formats)
3 email announcements (existing customers, prospects, stakeholders)
1 press release + media list (fintech journalists, business publications)
1 thought leadership article (founder/CEO byline, 1,500 words, placement support)
Post-launch brand sentiment report (week 2, week 4)

title: Lead Generation Bootcamp: Digital Sales Funnel for B2B Fintech
objective: Build top-funnel awareness and mid-funnel engagement for B2B fintech product (treasury, lending platform, or API); target CFOs and finance ops managers; drive 50 qualified leads with 25% conversion rate to sales demo within 90 days.
target_audience: CFOs, Finance Directors, Treasurers, Finance Ops Managers at mid-market companies (turnover SGD 10M–500M); SG/regional; active on LinkedIn, email.
key_activities: Account-based marketing list build (300 target companies, contact data, research)
LinkedIn paid campaign (sponsored content, InMail, lead gen forms) targeting finance decision-makers
3 educational gated resources (whitepapers, case studies, webinar recording) with lead capture
Cold email sequence (5–email nurture, personalized per segment)
Weekly webinar or demo session (30–45 min, rotating Tues/Thurs, 12–15 registrants/week)
Sales enablement: lead scoring, handoff to sales team, CRM integration
kpis: 50 qualified leads (demo requests or sales-qualified prospects)
S$240–360 CAC (cost per lead, all channels)
40% open rate on cold email sequence
why_now: July is peak budget planning and H2 initiative scoping for finance teams. Webinars and educational content perform well when executives have time to invest (school holidays = less operational chaos). Q3 product launches align with H2 fintech demand.
deliverables: Target account list (300 companies, decision-maker contact data, firmographic research)
LinkedIn paid campaign setup (3 sponsored content creatives, 2 InMail templates, lead gen forms)
3 gated educational resources (e.g., 'Treasury Automation ROI Playbook', 'SME Lending Case Study', 'CFO Guide to API Integration')
5-email cold email sequence (templates + personalization variables for sales team)
3 monthly webinar briefs + host talking points (rotating industry experts or internal thought leaders)
Sales enablement package (lead scoring criteria, CRM template, handoff SOP)
Weekly performance dashboard (LinkedIn ROAS, email metrics, lead pipeline status)
Post-campaign analysis: CAC breakdown, conversion funnel analysis, recommendations for scaling
